files.content:
# Preserve the release's user-owned comment.
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: payments
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  releaseName: payments
  targetNamespace: prod
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: ./charts/payments
      sourceRef:
        kind: GitRepository
        name: gitops
        namespace: flux-system
  values:
    app:
      replicas: 3
      resources:
        requests:
          cpu: 100m
          memory: 128Mi
  postRenderers:
    - kustomize:
        patches:
          - target:
              group: apps
              version: v1
              kind: Deployment
              name: payments\-api
              namespace: prod
            patch: |-
              apiVersion: apps/v1
              kind: Deployment
              metadata:
                name: payments-api
                namespace: prod
                annotations:
                  greenkube.cloud/managed: 'true'
                  greenkube.cloud/action-id: act-1
              spec:
                template:
                  spec:
                    containers:
                    - name: api
                      resources:
                        requests:
                          cpu: 300m
                          memory: 256Mi
